in_sanskrit.name: भिक्षा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who asks or begs, or the one who seeks alms. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word भिक्षा (bhikshA), which means 'alms, begging, or mendicant'. It is also associated with Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted as accepting offerings or being approached by devotees seeking his blessings.

in_hindi.name: भिक्कन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who asks for or begs for something. This name is derived from the Hindi word भिक्कन (bhikkAn), which is a derivative of the Sanskrit word भिक्षा (bhikshA).

in_tamil.name: பிக்கன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who approaches or serves a temple or god. This name is derived from the Tamil word பிக்கன் (piggan), which is derived from the Sanskrit word भिक्षा (bhikshA).

in_telugu.name: బీఖన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who approaches or serves a temple or god. This name is derived from the Telugu word బీఖన్ (beekhan), which is derived from the Sanskrit word भिक्षा (bhikshA).
